title: EnterpriseRAG: Benchmarking LLM Instruction Adherence and Robustness under Non-Ideal Enterprise Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.11584v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise RAG deployments face a critical reliability gap: while LLMs satisfy 80% of individual constraints, only 26.8% of responses meet all requirements simultaneously, revealing a 57-point orchestration gap. Existing benchmarks assume clean retrieval with simple queries, failing to capture production conditions where noisy documents and multi-dimensional constraints coexist. We introduce EnterpriseRAG, a benchmark of 983 expert-validated samples across six domains that systematically simulates three failure modes absent from prior work: retrieval noise, knowledge gaps, and factual conflicts, coupled with complex instructions. Evaluation of 13 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals a severe instruction adherence collapse, where high per-constraint satisfaction masks low holistic compliance. translated_title: 企业级RAG：非理想企业检索下LLM指令遵循性与鲁棒性的基准测试
translated_abstract: 企业级RAG部署面临一个关键可靠性缺口：尽管LLM能满足80%的单个约束条件，但只有26.8%的响应能同时满足所有要求，揭示了57个百分点的编排缺口。现有基准假设检索干净且查询简单，未能捕捉到噪声文档和多维约束共存的真实生产条件。我们引入了EnterpriseRAG，一个包含983个专家验证样本、覆盖六个领域的基准测试，系统性地模拟了以往工作缺失的三种失败模式：检索噪声、知识缺口和事实冲突，并伴有复杂指令。对13个最先进的LLM评估揭示了严重的指令遵循崩溃，即高单约束满足率掩盖了低整体合规率。关键发现暴露了知识缺口和事实冲突下的深层障碍，即使在增强推理的情况下也是如此，表明生产级RAG需要更稳健的机制。
tldr: 该论文提出了企业级RAG基准测试，发现LLM在复杂指令和噪声检索下存在严重的整体合规性崩溃，仅26.8%的响应能同时满足所有约束，暴露了生产环境中的关键可靠性缺口。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EnterpriseRAG, a benchmark revealing severe holistic compliance collapse in LLMs under complex instructions and noisy retrieval, with only 26.8% of responses meeting all constraints, exposing critical reliability gaps in production environments.
